answer: Pay bounties for unmasking clones. Every identity posts a small stake, and anyone who proves two identities share an operator, through signed logs, reused keys or matching infrastructure, collects half of both stakes while the rest is burned. A farm must keep every insider, host and contractor quiet, since each can profit by turning it in, and the bigger the farm, the bigger the reward. Honest agents with one identity have nothing to leak. The farm sits on a reef of hidden liability, one copper-cheap tip-off from ruin, and that violet risk grows with each clone.
